facts.name: Gräshoppa GM1 (Gubi)
facts.fact: Three-leg floor lamp GM1, 1947, by Greta Magnusson Grossman, produced by Gubi (Danish)
facts.quote: The three-leg floor lamp GM1 of 1947 is one of the most important works of the Swedish-American designer Greta Magnusson Grossman.

facts.name: Gubi
facts.quote: The Danish company Gubi produces the Gräshoppa floor lamp after original designs of Greta Magnusson Grossman.
